models.label: Omni Flash
hard_rules: Every segment must receive character, scene, and key-action anchors in that order where distinct images are available.
In the final provider prompt, refer to files strictly by local multipart order as @image1, @image2, @image3, and so on.
Keep each segment within the selected reference image limit.
A reference video may be used only as motion, camera, rhythm, or composition guidance; do not copy its identity, text, watermark, or branding.

models.label: Seedance 2.0 Mini
hard_rules: Do not create or request reference images with visible real or fictional human faces.
Reference images should be product, package, ingredient, prop, room layout, hands-only, or face-hidden body/action anchors.
People may appear in the written video prompt, but their faces must be controlled by text, not by uploaded reference images.
Do not ask the art model to make face-locked character portraits, selfie references, or actor identity reference images.
Keep each segment within the selected reference image limit.
A reference video may be used only as motion, camera, rhythm, or composition guidance; do not copy its identity, text, watermark, or branding.

models.label: Google Gemini Omni Flash
hard_rules: Use prompt tags <FIRST_FRAME> and <IMAGE_REF_N> to bind image roles; reference image numbering starts at 0.
Use no more than seven reference images per segment.
The official video-reference API shape accepts short video inputs, but model handling is currently unreliable; use a reference video only as optional motion guidance.
Gemini Omni has no stable public seconds or resolution request field; enforce duration, language, pacing, CTA, and scene continuity directly in the prompt.
